title: ChatContact/get: ids=[] (empty array) fetches zero contacts but returns empty notFound — correct but undocumented edge case
description: RFC 8620 §5.1 says if ids is an empty array the server SHOULD return an empty list without any notFound entries. The current code iterates the empty list and returns ([], []) which is correct. However there is no test for this boundary case, and the loop-based lookup is O(n) database calls for n IDs. An empty ids array triggers zero DB calls, which is fine, but the lack of a test means someone changing the implementation could silently break this boundary. File as P2 to add a test.
